item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pinellas County Schools shares timeline for consolidation recommendations and public input
item.description: The District will present consolidation recommendations next month to the School Board, that's as they review community feedback on cost-cutting measures.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US stocks rise to a record as oil prices drop and inflation gets less bad
item.description: The U.S. stock market rose to an all-time high Thursday following the latest sign that inflation is getting less bad. Stocks also got a lift from easing oil prices in their latest yo-yo move.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Dade City girl’s act of kindness grows into nonprofit feeding 1,600 children each week
item.description: What began as an act of kindness by a Pasco County first grader has grown into a nonprofit that now helps feed more than 1,600 children every week.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Mother devastated after family graves vandalized and stolen from in Lacooche cemetery
item.description: A Pasco County mother is devastated after several graves at a Lacoochee cemetery were vandalized and items connected to her family were stolen.
